description.en: Tells whether a brightness fade started with CMND_BRIGHT_FADE_ALL is still in progress. While an event has its bottom-screen background loaded (the EvSubBg image), it checks the top and the bottom screen, whatever screen is asked.

true while the fade is in progress, false otherwise.
null if the script system is not ready.

examples.case: Inside StartBrightFade for both screens (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut)
